chapter: Ch. 4, Table 4-2 Note 1 vs. Preface 'Evidence boundary' (PDF p.17 / printed xi)
evidence: Preface (PDF p.17, printed xi): 'Axis note: [ILLUSTRATIVE] is a provenance tag (Axis 1) only — a non-canonical worked example — and is never a measurement status; measurement status uses ANALYTICAL, SCENARIO-DERIVED, MODELED, MEASURED or UNMEASURED.' Table 4-2 Note 1 (PDF p.87, printed 67): 'Axis 3 measurement status — how far it has climbed the measurement hierarchy: ANALYTICAL / ILLUSTRATIVE / MODELED / MEASURED, or UNMEASURED.' Body usage follows the Preface (e.g. Fig 8.2 tag 'ANALYTICAL [DERIVED]', Ch. 2 'Analytical bound — not a benchmark').
issue: The two definitions of the Axis-3 measurement-status enumeration contradict each other. Note 1 lists ILLUSTRATIVE as a measurement status, which the Preface explicitly forbids ('never a measurement status'), and Note 1 omits SCENARIO-DERIVED, which the Preface mandates. Since the evidence-label apparatus is the book's core discipline and Note 1 is the declared authority chapters refer back to, a reader applying Note 1 would tag scenario-derived values with a status the Preface bans.
fix_instruction: Rewrite Note 1's Axis-3 enumeration to match the Preface set exactly: 'ANALYTICAL / SCENARIO-DERIVED / MODELED / MEASURED, or UNMEASURED', and add a cross-note that [ILLUSTRATIVE] is Axis-1-only (mirroring the Preface Axis note).

chapter: Preface, Reading conventions (vs. Ch. 6 §6.3.3 source-key convention)
evidence: Preface (PDF p.20, printed xiv): 'read any "meets 1.2 s" statement as conditional on a named tested workload and end-to-end timing (S-01).' Ch. 6 (PDF p.131, printed 111): 'each [S#] names one entry in the References chapter, where [S3]–[S7] resolve; Ch 11 lists [S1]–[S6] inline.' All other keys in the visible text use bracketed [S3]/[S4]/[S5]/[S6]/[S7] form.
issue: The Preface's only source key is written '(S-01)' — a hyphenated, parenthesized form that does not match the book's declared '[S#]' key convention used everywhere else. A reader cannot tell whether 'S-01' is the same entry as '[S1]' or a distinct key, so the citation is not resolvable under the book's own rule ('each [S#] names one entry in the References chapter').
fix_instruction: Rewrite '(S-01)' as '[S1]' (or whichever [S#] entry it denotes) so the key format matches the References-chapter convention used in Ch. 6/7/8.

evidence: PDF p.55 (printed 35): 'is carried in Appendix A §9A (alternative inference in detail)' and 'The full treatment is in Appendix A §9A.'; PDF p.67 (printed 47): 'is in Appendix A §9A, "Noise-stage expert selection (Wan2.2 A14B)".' Contrast the Appendix-A form used elsewhere: PDF p.66 (printed 46) 'Appendix A's §A.7 (Fig A.2, vendor-relative KV/compute ratios)'; Preface (PDF p.19, printed xii) 'Appendix A, A.6 carries a boxed 2026-09-27 capability probe' and '(Appendix A, A.3)'.
issue: Four citations to the same target use the form 'Appendix A §9A', which violates the book's declared convention ('Section cross-references use the § chapter.section form', PDF p.20/printed xiii) and is inconsistent with the A.N numbering style used for all other Appendix A citations (A.3, A.6, §A.7). The §9A target itself lies beyond the provided page range and could not be confirmed to exist.
fix_instruction: Renumber/normalize the target to the Appendix A scheme (e.g. '§A.9A' or 'A.9') and update all four occurrences (two in §3.1.1, one in the §3.1.1 reader-orientation box, one in §3.6.2); verify the target section exists under the new label.

evidence: Ch. 8 (PDF p.180, printed 160): 'the weight-only intensity above omits the per-sequence KV re-read: 2.62 MB/token × 9,200 tokens ≈ 24.1 GB (FP16, full-MHA; Ch 6).' Ch. 6's decode treatment (PDF pp.129–131, printed 109–111: §6.3.3 and Table 6-1) states only the 140 GB weight read, the 5.6 TB/s aggregate figure and the 0.70 TB/s sharded figure — the 24.1 GB KV figure appears nowhere in Ch. 6. The value's derivation home is Table 7-1 (PDF p.141, printed 121: '9,200 × 2,621,440 B') and Table 4-2 (PDF p.87, printed 67).
issue: Wrong-chapter citation: the '(FP16, full-MHA; Ch 6)' provenance pointer attributes the 24.1 GB per-sequence KV re-read to Chapter 6, but Chapter 6 never states or derives that number; the cited-topic test fails. The arithmetic itself is correct (2.62 MB/token × 9,200 ≈ 24.1 GB).
fix_instruction: Repoint the citation to its actual source: '(FP16, full-MHA; Ch 7 Table 7-1)' or '(Ch 4, Table 4-2)'.

chapter: Ch. 7, Figure 7.3 (title vs. caption vs. List of Figures)
evidence: In-figure title on PDF p.152 (printed 132): 'Quantization choices are not execution guarantees'. Same-page caption: 'figure 7.3: Quantization choices and execution paths: quantization (calibration) method, numerical representation, packed tensors and checkpoint container describe different parts of a deployment…'. List of Figures (PDF p.10): '7.3 Quantization choices and execution paths . . . 132'.
issue: The figure's internal headline semantically diverges from its formal caption and its List-of-Figures entry ('not execution guarantees' vs. 'and execution paths'). This is the only figure in the visible range whose in-figure title changes the claim rather than merely abbreviating it (other variances, e.g. Fig 2.2/7.5–7.8, are purely abbreviations), so a reader skimming the figure alone gets a different statement than the caption and LoF provide.
fix_instruction: Harmonize the three titles — either retitle the in-figure headline to 'Quantization choices and execution paths' (matching caption and LoF) or update the caption and LoF entry to the 'not execution guarantees' wording, so all three agree.

evidence: Instances of the compressed form: PDF p.101 (printed 81) '(Ch 2 §1, developed in Ch 11)'; PDF p.96 (printed 76) '(canonical statement in Ch 7 §3, Fig 7.7)'; PDF p.105 (printed 85) 'from Ch 7 §3 and Ch 20'; PDF p.133 (printed 113) '(35% MFU, Ch 8 §3)'; PDF p.134 (printed 114) 'Ch 8 §3, Table 8-1' and '(Ch 8 §3; Ch 17)'. Declared convention (PDF p.20, printed xiii): 'Section cross-references use the § chapter.section form: a bare § N.M refers to chapter N, section M'.
issue: Recurring nonconforming cross-reference form 'Ch N §M' instead of the declared '§ N.M' form. All six instances were verified to resolve to existing, on-topic targets (§2.1 terminology table; §7.3 worked example; §8.3.3–8.3.4 prefill screens), so this is a form-only defect, but it recurs across at least three chapters and undermines the convention the Preface states.
fix_instruction: Rewrite the instances as '§ 2.1', '§ 7.3', '§ 8.3' respectively (six occurrences across printed pp. 76, 81, 85, 113, 114×2); run a global search for '§[0-9]' preceded by 'Ch' to catch any remaining instances in the unrendered chapters.
